title: A Thorn for the Veil Again
author: Dominic Whitlock
blurb: Rosalind Delacroix, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
